nodes.label: task_struct
nodes.description: The process descriptor — the central kernel data structure representing a process or thread. Every running task in the system has exactly one task_struct allocated for it.

nodes.label: files_struct
nodes.description: The open-file table for a process; contains the file-descriptor table (fdtable) that maps integer file descriptors to struct file pointers. Shared across threads within the same thread group.

nodes.label: file
nodes.description: Represents an open file instance; created each time a file is opened and holds per-open state such as the current position, access flags, and a pointer into the VFS path. Multiple file structs may reference the same inode.

nodes.label: inode
nodes.description: The VFS inode — the filesystem-independent representation of a file or directory object on disk. Holds metadata (size, timestamps, permissions) and links to the filesystem-specific operations and the page cache.

nodes.label: address_space
nodes.description: The page-cache backing object associated with an inode; manages the radix tree of cached pages for file data. It acts as the bridge between the VFS/inode and the physical memory pages that cache file contents.

nodes.label: dentry
nodes.description: A directory-entry cache (dcache) object that maps a filename component to its inode; maintained in an LRU cache to speed up path lookups without hitting the filesystem on every access.
